verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a bare 'AI & Automation' heading on Recruitee's features page. It does not show that AI screens or matches candidates against a role, and nothing explains how such AI works or what safeguards apply to automated decisions. The audit logs cover data changes, not AI decisions. Missing for 10: evidence of AI candidate screening/matching against job requirements, documentation of how the AI works, documented safeguards for automated decisions (human review, bias controls, transparency), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
